question: Who was the first sultan (in the recorded history of the Dargah Sharif) to visit the shrine of khwaja Muinuddin Chisti?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad bin Tughluq**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Muhammad bin Tughluq** was the first Sultan to visit the shrine of Khwaja Muinuddin Chisti.
 
• Muhammad bin Tughluq ruled from **1325 to 1351** and was known for his ambitious projects and eccentric ideas.
